The optimization cycle involves three main steps: (1) compute a scaling factor that precisely fits the sequence length while maintaining convex structure, (2) solve a sparse linear program that enforces maximum autocorrelation constraints, and (3) combine the reference sequence with the LP solution. This avoids the combinatorial pitfalls of the stochastic search while using the combination operator to facilitate dimensionality reduction and faster convergence to the bounded optimum.
